1. FCV turns on or off the features that persist data in a format earlier MongoDB versions cannot read. https://www.mongodb.com/docs/v6.0/reference/command/setFeatureCompatibilityVersion.md 2. When you upgrade the binaries, the deployment keeps running at the previous FCV. The FCV changes only when you raise it. https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongodb-versions/ 3. A new deployment starts at its own version's FCV. A deployment upgraded from the previous release keeps the old FCV, for example "5.0" on 6.0 binaries, until you set it. https://www.mongodb.com/docs/v6.0/reference/command/setFeatureComp
